dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts the Lester B. Pearson International Airport (LBPIA) operating area, which effects various land use requirements. This layer is similar to the linear dataset on other schedules.
The Lester B. Pearson International Airport Operating Area identifies lands influenced by airport operations, including aircraft noise and flight activity. Planning and development within this area must consider aviation safety, noise compatibility, and airport protection requirements while supporting appropriate land uses.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
dct_title_s: Brampton Plan-Schedule 12-Lester B. Pearson International Airport LBPIA Operating Area
